fires.held_fire: Job b919c533 armed 02:12:49; an 80s foreground Bash turn ran 02:13:06 to 02:14:31; the fire due during it ran once at 02:14:33, right after that turn's result.

scheduler_2_1_284.config_override: tengu_kairos_cron_config feature flag may replace the defaults at runtime.
scheduler_2_1_284.recurring_next_fire: i = next match after anchor (createdAt, then each fire time); o = next match after i minus i; if cron matches ^\*/\d+ \* \* \* \*$ and 15s < o, o >= 5min and o - 15s < 5min: anchor + o - 15s; else i + min(frac(id) x recurringFrac x o, recurringCapMs), frac(id) = first 8 hex chars of the id / 2^32.
scheduler_2_1_284.one_shot_fire: the next match, or up to oneShotMaxMs earlier when its minute is a multiple of oneShotMinuteMod.
scheduler_2_1_284.age_out: a recurring job is deleted after its first fire at or past recurringMaxAgeMs since creation.
scheduler_2_1_284.cron_grammar: 5 whitespace-separated fields (minute 0-59, hour 0-23, day of month 1-31, month 1-12, day of week 0-6 with 7 = 0); each a comma list of *, */n, a-b, a-b/n or n; no names. Matching uses local time; day of month and day of week are ORed when both are restricted, and a field whose set covers its whole range counts as unrestricted.
